37 mins ago

India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall over Bihar, Karnataka, Himachal Pradesh, and Jammu-Kashmir for the day.
IMD said that conditions are becoming favourable for further withdrawal of Southwest Monsoon from some more parts of Eastern India and Northern Peninsula, and many parts of Northeast India during the next 2 to 3 days.
The Met Department said that thunderstorms and lightning conditions will continue over Delhi, Haryana, Chandigarh, Punjab, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala and Mahe till tomorrow.
